1225: Patent boilerplate ("invention") — fires on "invention" in the stock patent opener "The present invention relates to…".
1901: Patent/academic "present" — fires on "present" in formal phrasing like "The present invention/experiment…".
436: Closing XML/HTML tag — fires on the ", , ).
433: Forum question header ("Q:") — fires on the colon in "Q:" that opens a StackExchange-style question.
65: Opening curly quote — fires on the opening “smart” double-quote just before a quoted phrase.
1164: Closing curly quote — fires on the closing “smart” double-quote at the end of a quoted phrase.
